title: I made the Catacombs game I’ve always wanted.
author: acexprt
selftext:
For years I’ve had this idea for a game where you have to escape the Paris Catacombs. I’ve done a lot of planning on how to make this without going down the horror route. I wanted to make it realistic with psychological horror elements.

Main features:  
Survival stats.  
Plotting  your own map,  
Inventory system.  
Procedural maps so every run is new.  
Save and load games. ( longest run was 45 minutes)

I used 100% Claude AI with Unity.  
It’s procedurally generated maps where you have to escape. Keep your sanity and don’t starve or die of thirst. Depending on the mode you play you may have to watch out for the keepers of the catacombs as they try to chase you away.

This is only phase one. I’d like to add some coop and expand on the generation features. I’m also going to be adding a feature that allows players to place their mark permanently in the game for everyone to see.

I’ve  put about 30 hours into it.  Voice dialog comes next but it’s 100% playable and fun as it stands. Would love some feedback for this who like exploration, getting lost, and charting your own maps.
